releasePolicy: BACKTEST_ALL_GREEN_ONLY=GREEN and RELEASE_GATE=GREEN are mandatory for formal forecast publishing

accept: Review decisions cite full Git SHA, exact CI run and independent evidence
Block all FAIL/WARN_BLOCKING/UNKNOWN/BACKTEST_INSUFFICIENT
No production release without all mandatory prerequisites
Permanently distinguish unauthorized, missing, stale, incomplete, simulated and valid source data
Test throttling/timeout/429/401/403 and source recovery
Provide by-league coverage and real provider rights evidence or BLOCKED
Replays bind source/event/team IDs, revision, observedAt and exact input hashes
Conflict, rescheduling and future-data leakage tests pass
Missing data remains explicitly unavailable
Per-league prospective sample counts, Brier, LogLoss, calibration, abstention, benchmark and odds utility
No future information or post-hoc selection in validation
Never claim >=62% or ~70% unless independent evidence supports it
Opening observedAt is provider-original and earlier than latest market observedAt
Two independently sourced paired quotes meet policy and valid temporal boundaries
Zero verified candidates is acceptable until valid data exists
All user-visible forecast delivery paths fail closed when BACKTEST_ALL_GREEN_ONLY or RELEASE_GATE is missing
No duplicate Telegram delivery after uncertain acknowledgement; no raw tokens in logs
Actual website receipt requires same reportId/hash as ECS and authenticated HTTPS smoke
Never infer production SHA from repository; obtain actual ECS evidence from authorized operator
Test restart persistence, reportId health, safe rollback and existing weidu-bridge compatibility
Fail closed without authorized ECS identity or full GREEN release gate
No session or backend token leaks; anonymous cannot read protected content
